step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Two-Stage Operational Amplifier with Continuous-Time Common-Mode Feedback (CMFB)
step1_analysis.description: The circuit amplifies the differential signal between IN_PLUS and IN_MINUS. It uses a continuous-time CMFB circuit (XM4, XM6, XM7, XM9) to compare the output common-mode voltage against VCOM and adjust the first-stage active loads (XM3, XM8) to stabilize the output DC operating point.

paper_reference.title: A Complete Single-Chip GPS Receiver With 1.6-V 24-mW Radio in 0.18-um CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_tail1(100u) + I_tail2(50u) + I_tail3(50u) + I_load1(100u) + I_load2(100u) = 400uA. Power = 400uA * 1.8V = 0.72mW
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the added bias currents required to keep the 5u/0.5u transistors in saturation.
Typical two-stage op-amp gain in 180nm/130nm processes.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm11 / (2 * pi * Cc) = 526uS / (2 * pi * 1pF) = 83.7 MHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by input pair transconductance and Miller compensation capacitor.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Cc=1pF and Cl=1pF, the non-dominant pole is at gm2 / (2 * pi * Cl) = 317uS / (2 * pi * 1pF) = 50 MHz. Since this is close to UGBW (83 MHz), PM will be around 45-50 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the ratio of load capacitance to compensation capacitance.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the first stage tail current charging the Miller capacitor.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, open-loop differential gain, UGBW, phase margin, and slew rate. Missing tail and load current sources have been added to properly bias the extracted netlist.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Op-Amp Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameters from netlist
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT_PLUS N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N8 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM5 N7 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4 N7 OUT_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 N3 VCOM N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N7 OUT_PLUS N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N10 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 VCOM N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 OUT_MINUS N10 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N8 IN_PLUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N10 IN_MINUS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Missing Bias and Load Sources (required for operation)
I_tail1 N4 0 100u
I_tail2 N1 0 50u
I_tail3 N5 0 50u
I_load1 OUT_PLUS 0 100u
I_load2 OUT_MINUS 0 100u

* Compensation and Load Capacitors
Cc1 OUT_PLUS N8 1p
Cc2 OUT_MINUS N10 1p
Cl1 OUT_PLUS 0 1p
Cl2 OUT_MINUS 0 1p

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VCOM VCOM 0 0.9
VIN_PLUS IN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.9 1.0 100n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
VIN_MINUS IN_MINUS 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.9 0.8 100n 1n 1n 1u 2u)

* Dependent source for differential output
E_diff OUT_DIFF 0 OUT_PLUS OUT_MINUS 1.0

* Control Block
.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
  let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_margin_raw find phase_deg when gain_db=0 fall=1
  let phase_margin = 180 + phase_margin_raw
  print phase_margin

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 2u
  meas tran v_max max v(OUT_DIFF)
  meas tran v_min min v(OUT_DIFF)
  meas tran t_rise trig v(OUT_DIFF) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=1.5 rise=1
  let slew_rate_V_us = (1.0 / t_rise) * 1e-6
  print slew_rate_V_us
  
  quit
.endc
.end
